idea: Compute a level of service per road section from a service measure (freeway/multilane density in pc/mi/ln: A<=11, B 11-18, C 18-26, D 26-35, E 35-45, F>45 or demand>capacity; stop-controlled delay s: A<=10,B 10-15... ; signalised arterial by average travel speed against base free-flow speed) and give the measure value alongside the letter.
does: Grades every road (and junction approach) from a run or from AADT as LOS A-F with the measure that decided it; lists worst sections.
outputs: per road: measure (density, delay, ATS), LOS letter, v/c
notes: Density = veh/km/lane converted from pc/mi; simulation gives it directly from detector/lane occupancy.

idea: Invert the LOS procedure to get the maximum AADT (or hourly volume) each LOS letter can carry for a given lane count, truck percent, terrain; service volumes are the max volumes still inside the LOS range. Dual carriageways: halve AADT. Built by applying the tool iteratively, so tables update when the procedure changes.
does: Answers how much demand a road can take at LOS C/D before degrading, by bisection on the LOS function.
inputs: road/lane count, truck share, speed, signal g/C
notes: Bisection by the standard library; lets the assistant size demand against a LOS target.

idea: Capacity defaults: rural two-lane one-way 1,490 veh/h; stop-controlled 1,200 (1 lane) or 1,500 veh/h otherwise; signalised capacity = saturation flow x lanes x g/C using only the through movement, deducting 10 percent for each exclusive left/right lane when only total volume is known; freeway capacity from FFS and heavy-vehicle factor.
does: Fast planning-level capacity per road/approach without a run, for screening v/c.
existing: partial: critical_links; roundabout capacity only sizes demand
notes: HERS vs NCHRP 825 compared: HERS signalised capacity 14% lower (lane width, trucks, parking, PHF adjustments).

topic: Default fill-in policy for missing inputs
idea: When inputs are missing, assume defaults from medians of the records that have them (cycle 120/90/60 s for principal/minor/collector; conflicting flow table 100-750 veh/h by class and land use) and refuse LOS where no defensible default exists (urban unsignalised sections not graded, since 100% green would mislead).
does: Assistant states which inputs were defaulted and withholds a metric when its default would mislead.
notes: A reporting convention rather than a model.
